Create the file /workspace/tests/Playwright.Tests/tests/03-enrollment.spec.ts

This is a Playwright test file for enrollment flows (User Story 1).

The test file should contain test suite "Enrollment Smoke":
   a. "enroll in a course from detail page" — as bob@example.com/password123 (not yet enrolled in "Advanced .NET Patterns"), navigates to that course detail, clicks "Enroll now" button, verifies success message or "✓ Enrolled" button appears
   b. "view my courses shows enrolled courses" — navigates to /MyCourses/Index, verifies at least one course appears in the enrollment list (#enrollment-list)

Use:
- import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'
- import { testUsers } from '../utils/testUsers'
- Helper function to login with email/password
- Course detail page has: h1 with title, "Enroll now" button (role button "Enroll now"), "✓ Enrolled" when enrolled
- My Courses page has: #enrollment-list div with enrollment rows

Important: After clicking "Enroll now" (HTMX POST), wait for the enroll region to update. The button text should change to "✓ Enrolled" after successful enrollment.
